title: Heat-Shock Transformation Protocol
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7j2hkqe

steps.title: Add Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Add the plasmid DNA to the competent cells using one of the following quantities: 1 µL of miniprep, 2 µL of ligation mixture, or the specified volume of cesium-purified DNA.

steps.title: Incubate on Ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Heat Shock
steps.instruction: Heat shock the cells at exactly 42ºC for exactly 1:30 minutes, then immediately chill on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Culture Cells
steps.instruction: Culture the cells in 1 mL SOC for 1 hour at 37ºC; pre-warm the agar plates during this time.

steps.title: Concentrate Culture
steps.instruction: Spin the culture down at 3000rpm for 3 minutes, discard 900 µL of the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in the remaining 100 µL.

steps.title: Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Plate the cells onto agar plates containing the appropriate antibiotic, if applicable.

steps.title: Repeat Heat Shock
steps.instruction: Repeat the heat shock process (Step 3) once.
